Title: [LSJ] Force of Will vs Ashes to Ashes

Messages.Author: pd...@lightlink.com
Messages.Body:
So I'm a George Fredrick. I go to Force of Will at superior (so I'm
taking a point of aggro at the end of the action). I get blocked, and
in the ensuing combat, I play Ashes to Ashes at superior, untapping me,
giving me 2 blood, and sending me to torpor. Combat ends, and I still
have to take the 1 point of aggro from the FoW:

A) I assume I have to burn one blood for it to avoid destruction,
'cause the AtA sending me to torpor is essentially "wounding" me,
correct?

B) If I don't have the blood to burn ('cause I played AtA at, um,
inferior?), and have zero blood, and am going to torpor due to the AtA
already, does the point of aggro from FoW burn me?

Thanks,
-Peter
